g.text: BARE ESP32-P4NRW16X V3 - ENGINEERING DRAFT - NO DEV BOARD

g.desc: BARE ESP32-P4NRW16X V3 - ENGINEERING DRAFT - NO DEV BOARD

g.text: J701: 1GND 2TARGET3V3 3MCU_TX 4MCU_RX 5RESET 6BOOT35. Powered target only; no programmer-powered rail.

g.desc: J701: 1GND 2TARGET3V3 3MCU_TX 4MCU_RX 5RESET 6BOOT35. Powered target only; no programmer-powered rail.

g.text: BOOT35=1 SPI boot; hold BOOT35 low with BOOT36 high during reset for UART download. Keep straps stable >=3ms after reset.

g.desc: BOOT35=1 SPI boot; hold BOOT35 low with BOOT36 high during reset for UART download. Keep straps stable >=3ms after reset.

g.text: Flash 4MB requires matching firmware partitions/driver validation. PSRAM LDO requires software configuration; unused LDO3/4 remain unloaded.
